reviewCharts.sourceCoverage: Machine-readable OpenElections county source files, selected text-layer OpenElections PDFs, reconciled official Monroe County detail rows, plus legacy NYC local review rows; image-only, president-only, unsupported, or unreviewed counties are not included in this review-row CSV yet.
reviewCharts.warning: New York local review rows are election-district President-versus-U.S. Senate comparisons normalized from machine-readable OpenElections county source files, selected text-layer OpenElections PDFs, reconciled official Monroe County detail rows, plus legacy NYC local review rows. Image-only, president-only, unsupported, or unreviewed counties are not included yet, and county-certified result totals remain the map authority.

turnout.notes: New York turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows until a state-native turnout artifact is collected.

historicalBaselines.warning: New York historical baseline rows are county-level presidential results from official NYSBOE general-election PDFs for 2012, 2016, and 2020. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data. 2012 and 2016 include separate official presidential write-in final totals; 2020 uses the presidential table write-in column.
